A '''battle''' occurred between [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Pentastar Alignment]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Palanhi/Legends|Palanhi]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. This battle took part of the offensive planned by [[reborn]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to reconquer the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Those assaults were executed by the reunified [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] and loyal Imperial forces prior to the launch of [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] was charged to reconquer the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]], including the northern part of the Core. This battle allowed the Empire to control [[Palanhi/Legends|Palanhi]] and attack [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This battle makes its first appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. The battle is only illustrated on the galactic map of the conflict.
